notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Triskelavite tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Triskelavite token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the other Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Repeat.
